title: Remove legacy test database references
scope: Remove only the legacy test database name and direct references from backend test configuration; preserve the real productdb database, migrations, and production connection settings.
plan: Use a dedicated CI test database name in dotenv.env and the integration workflow, while leaving the production-only reset verification outside the generic CI integration job.
Require TEST_DATABASE_URL explicitly in integration test mains, require a database name, and reject the production productdb database with a clear configuration error.
Remove the orphaned test seed utility after confirming it has no references.
Add focused configuration tests covering missing TEST_DATABASE_URL and production-database protection.
Run gofmt, focused tests, go test ./..., go vet, and the shared documentation generator/tests.
safety: Do not connect to, modify, delete, or create localhost:5432/productdb; do not create containers; do not modify migrations or unrelated files.
